description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Athula Kernal Peiris as a Member of the Moratuwa M/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Moratuwa Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member to fill a seat vacated due to a party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election-related matters (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations for local government elections.
